docs.title: Braised Eggplant | 红烧茄子
docs.text: Quick Info | 快速信息 - ⏱️ Prep Time | 准备时间: 10 minutes | 10分钟 - 🔥 Cook Time | 烹饪时间: 10 minutes | 10分钟 - 🍽️ Servings | 份量: 1 serving | 1人份 - 📊 Difficulty | 难度: Easy | 简单

docs.title: 📝 Description | 菜品介绍
docs.text:
English: This classic braised eggplant is soft, flavorful, and absorbs the savory sauce beautifully. The eggplant becomes melt-in-your-mouth tender while maintaining its shape. This simple one-ingredient-focused recipe takes only 20 minutes and pairs perfectly with steamed rice. It's a comforting Chinese home-style dish that's naturally vegan.

中文： 这道经典红烧茄子柔软入味，完美吸收咸鲜酱汁。茄子变得入口即化同时保持形状完整。这道以单一食材为主的简单菜谱仅需20分钟，与蒸米饭搭配完美。这是一道天然素食的中式家常 comfort food。

docs.title: 🥘 Ingredients | 食材清单
docs.text:
Ingredient 食材 Quantity 分量 Notes 备注 Eggplant 茄子 250g 250克 1 medium eggplant 1个中等大小茄子 Garlic 大蒜 10g 10克 Minced (2-3 cloves) 切末（2-3瓣） Ginger 姜 5g 5克 Minced 切末 Salt 盐 2g 2克 To taste 适量 Sugar 糖 4g 4克 Balance flavors 平衡味道 Soy Sauce 酱油 10ml 10毫升 Light soy sauce 生抽 Cooking Oil 食用油 20ml 20毫升 Vegetable oil 植物油 Water 水 80ml 80毫升 For braising 用于红烧 Cornstarch 玉米淀粉 5g 5克 Mixed with 10ml water 与10毫升水混合

Notes on Measurements | 分量说明: - All measurements are precise in grams (g) or milliliters (ml) for consistency 所有分量均以克(g)或毫升(ml)为单位，保持一致性 - One medium eggplant weighs approximately 250-300g 一个中等大小的茄子约重250-300克 - Eggplant absorbs oil easily, so measure oil carefully 茄子容易吸油，请仔细测量油量

docs.title: Step 1 | 第一步: Prepare the Eggplant | 准备茄子
docs.text:
English: Wash the eggplant thoroughly. Cut off the stem and slice into 2-3 cm thick rounds, then cut each round into quarters. Sprinkle 1g of salt over the eggplant pieces and let them sit for 5 minutes to draw out excess moisture. Pat dry with paper towels. Mince the garlic and ginger.

中文： 彻底清洗茄子。去掉蒂部，切成2-3厘米厚的圆片，然后将每片切成四等份。在茄子上撒1克盐，静置5分钟以去除多余水分。用厨房纸巾拍干。将大蒜和姜切末。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Salting reduces oil absorption and prevents the eggplant from becoming too greasy. 加盐可减少吸油量，防止茄子过于油腻。

docs.title: Step 2 | 第二步: Pan-Fry the Eggplant | 煎茄子
docs.text:
English: Heat a non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add 15ml of cooking oil and swirl to coat. Add the eggplant pieces in a single layer and cook for 3-4 minutes until golden brown on one side. Flip and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Remove and set aside.

中文： 将不粘锅或炒锅置于中大火上。加入15毫升食用油，晃动覆盖锅底。将茄子块单层放入，煎3-4分钟至一面金黄。翻面再煎2-3分钟。取出备用。

⚠️ Important | 注意事项: Don't overcrowd the pan; cook in batches if necessary for even browning. 不要过度拥挤锅子；必要时分批煎制以确保均匀上色。

docs.title: Step 3 | 第三步: Sauté Aromatics | 炒香调料
docs.text:
English: Add the remaining 5ml of oil to the same pan over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 15-20 seconds until fragrant. Be careful not to burn them.

中文： 在同一锅中加入剩余的5毫升油，中火加热。加入蒜末和姜末，翻炒15-20秒至出香味。注意不要烧焦。

🌟 Pro Tip | 专业技巧: Using the same pan retains all the flavorful bits from the eggplant. 使用同一个锅可保留茄子的所有风味物质。

docs.title: Step 4 | 第四步: Braise | 红烧
docs.text:
English: Return the fried eggplant to the pan. Add 80ml of water, 10ml of soy sauce, 1g of salt, and 4g of sugar. Stir gently to combine. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes until the eggplant is very tender.

中文： 将煎好的茄子放回锅中。加入80毫升水、10毫升酱油、1克盐和4克糖。轻轻搅拌使其混合。煮沸后转小火。盖上锅盖，慢炖5分钟至茄子非常软嫩。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: The eggplant should be fork-tender but still hold its shape. 茄子应该用叉子可以轻松刺穿但仍保持形状。

docs.title: Step 5 | 第五步: Thicken Sauce and Serve | 勾芡上桌
docs.text:
English: Mix 5g of cornstarch with 10ml of water to create a slurry. Remove the lid and increase heat to medium. Stir the cornstarch slurry and pour it into the pan while stirring constantly. Cook for 1 minute until the sauce thickens and coats the eggplant. Transfer to a serving plate and serve hot with steamed rice.

中文： 将5克玉米淀粉与10毫升水混合制成淀粉水。打开锅盖，将火调至中火。搅拌淀粉水并倒入锅中，同时不断搅拌。煮1分钟至酱汁浓稠并包裹茄子。装入盘中，趁热配蒸米饭食用。

docs.title: ✨ Characteristics | 菜品特点
docs.text:
Flavor Profile | 口味特点: - 🟢 Savory and Umami-Rich | 咸鲜味美 - 🟢 Melt-in-Your-Mouth Tender | 入口即化 - 🟢 Slightly Sweet | 微甜 - 🟢 Rich Sauce | 浓郁酱汁

Nutritional Highlights | 营养亮点: - Low in calories (only 25 kcal per 100g before cooking) | 低卡路里（烹饪前每100克仅25千卡） - High in dietary fiber | 富含膳食纤维 - Contains antioxidants like nasunin | 含有花青素等抗氧化物质 - Good source of potassium and magnesium | 良好的钾和镁来源

Best Served | 最佳食用方式: - Over steamed white rice (classic combination) | 配蒸白米饭（经典搭配） - With plain congee | 配白粥 - Alongside other vegetable dishes | 与其他蔬菜菜肴搭配 - Perfect for a comforting dinner | 适合温馨晚餐

docs.title: 🔄 Variations | 变化做法
docs.text:
Option 1 | 做法一: Spicy Version | 辣味版 Add 2g of chili bean paste (doubanjiang) when sautéing aromatics. 炒调料时加入2克豆瓣酱。

Option 2 | 做法二: Vinegar Finish | 醋溜版 Add 5ml of black vinegar at the end for a tangy note. 最后加入5毫升陈醋增加酸爽风味。

Option 3 | 做法三: Minimalist | 极简版 Skip the cornstarch slurry for a lighter, broth-like sauce. 省略淀粉水，获得更清淡的汤汁。

docs.title: 📌 Storage Tips | 储存建议
docs.text:
• Refrigerator | 冷藏: Store in an airtight container for up to 2 days 放入密封容器中冷藏，最多保存2天

  • Reheating | 重新加热: Reheat gently in a pan over low heat with a splash of water 用小火在锅中轻轻重新加热，加少许水

  • Freezing | 冷冻: Not recommended as the texture becomes mushy 不建议冷冻，因为质地会变软烂

  • Best enjoyed fresh | 最好现做现吃: For optimal texture, consume within 24 hours 为获得最佳口感，建议在24小时内食用

docs.title: Braised Tomatoes | 红烧番茄
docs.text: Quick Info | 快速信息 - ⏱️ Prep Time | 准备时间: 5 minutes | 5分钟 - 🔥 Cook Time | 烹饪时间: 8 minutes | 8分钟 - 🍽️ Servings | 份量: 1 serving | 1人份 - 📊 Difficulty | 难度: Easy | 简单

docs.title: 📝 Description | 菜品介绍
docs.text:
English: This simple braised tomato dish showcases the natural umami and slight sweetness of ripe tomatoes. Cooked until tender with a rich sauce, it's perfect over rice or noodles. The recipe uses only tomatoes and basic seasonings, making it an ideal minimalist vegan meal that takes just 13 minutes to prepare.

中文： 这道简单的红烧番茄展现了成熟番茄的天然鲜味和微甜。煮至软嫩并带有浓郁酱汁，非常适合配米饭或面条。菜谱仅使用番茄和基本调味料，是理想的极简素食餐点，仅需13分钟即可完成。

docs.title: 🥘 Ingredients | 食材清单
docs.text:
Ingredient 食材 Quantity 分量 Notes 备注 Ripe Tomatoes 成熟番茄 200g 200克 2 medium tomatoes 2个中等大小番茄 Garlic 大蒜 6g 6克 Minced (1-2 cloves) 切末（1-2瓣） Salt 盐 2g 2克 To taste 适量 Sugar 糖 3g 3克 Balance acidity 平衡酸味 Cooking Oil 食用油 8ml 8毫升 Vegetable oil 植物油 Water 水 50ml 50毫升 For braising 用于红烧 Soy Sauce 酱油 5ml 5毫升 Light soy sauce 生抽

Notes on Measurements | 分量说明: - All measurements are precise in grams (g) or milliliters (ml) for consistency 所有分量均以克(g)或毫升(ml)为单位，保持一致性 - One medium tomato weighs approximately 100g 一个中等大小的番茄约重100克 - Adjust sugar based on tomato sweetness 根据番茄甜度调整糖的用量

docs.title: Step 1 | 第一步: Prepare the Tomatoes | 准备番茄
docs.text:
English: Wash the tomatoes thoroughly. Cut them into 2-3 cm cubes. If desired, you can peel them by blanching in boiling water for 30 seconds first. Peel and mince the garlic.

中文： 彻底清洗番茄。切成2-3厘米的方块。如需要，可以先在沸水中焯烫30秒去皮。大蒜去皮并切成细末。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Peeling is optional but creates a smoother sauce texture. 去皮是可选的，但能创造更顺滑的酱汁质地。

docs.title: Step 2 | 第二步: Sauté the Aromatics | 炒香调料
docs.text:
English: Place a small pot or deep pan over medium heat. Add 8ml of cooking oil and heat for 20 seconds. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry for 10 seconds until fragrant.

中文： 将小锅或深煎锅置于中火上。加入8毫升食用油，加热20秒。加入蒜末，翻炒10秒至出香味。

⚠️ Important | 注意事项: Use medium heat to prevent the garlic from burning. 使用中火防止大蒜烧焦。

docs.title: Step 3 | 第三步: Add Tomatoes | 加入番茄
docs.text:
English: Add the tomato cubes to the pot and stir-fry for 2 minutes until they start to soften and release their juices. Add 5ml of soy sauce and stir well.

中文： 将番茄块加入锅中，翻炒2分钟至开始变软并释放汁液。加入5毫升酱油，充分搅拌。

🌟 Pro Tip | 专业技巧: Stir gently to avoid breaking the tomatoes too much. 轻轻搅拌以避免过度破坏番茄形状。

docs.title: Step 4 | 第四步: Braise | 红烧
docs.text:
English: Add 50ml of water, 2g of salt, and 3g of sugar to the pot. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes until the tomatoes are tender and the sauce has thickened slightly.

中文： 向锅中加入50毫升水、2克盐和3克糖。煮沸后转小火。盖上锅盖，慢炖5分钟至番茄软嫩且酱汁略微浓稠。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: The sugar balances the natural acidity of the tomatoes perfectly. 糖完美平衡了番茄的天然酸味。

docs.title: Step 5 | 第五步: Reduce and Serve | 收汁上桌
docs.text:
English: Remove the lid and cook for another 1-2 minutes over medium heat to reduce the sauce to your desired consistency. Transfer to a serving bowl and serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.

中文： 打开锅盖，用中火再煮1-2分钟，将酱汁收至理想浓稠度。装入碗中，趁热配蒸米饭或面条食用。

docs.title: ✨ Characteristics | 菜品特点
docs.text:
Flavor Profile | 口味特点: - 🟢 Savory and Slightly Sweet | 咸甜适口 - 🟢 Rich Umami Flavor | 浓郁鲜味 - 🟢 Tender Texture | 软嫩口感 - 🟢 Comforting and Home-style | 家常温馨

Nutritional Highlights | 营养亮点: - Low in calories (only 18 kcal per 100g) | 低卡路里（每100克仅18千卡） - High in lycopene (powerful antioxidant) | 富含番茄红素（强效抗氧化剂） - Rich in Vitamin C and potassium | 富含维生素C和钾 - Good source of dietary fiber | 良好的膳食纤维来源

Best Served | 最佳食用方式: - Over steamed white rice | 配蒸白米饭 - With plain noodles | 配素面条 - As a side dish with tofu | 作为豆腐的配菜 - Perfect for a quick lunch | 适合快速午餐

docs.title: 🔄 Variations | 变化做法
docs.text:
Option 1 | 做法一: Herb Version | 香草版 Add 2g of dried basil or oregano for an Italian twist. 加入2克干罗勒或牛至，带来意式风味。

Option 2 | 做法二: Spicy Version | 辣味版 Add 1g of chili flakes during sautéing for heat. 炒制时加入1克辣椒碎增加辣味。

Option 3 | 做法三: Extra Saucy | 多汁版 Increase water to 80ml for more sauce to toss with pasta. 将水增加到80毫升，获得更多酱汁拌意面。

docs.title: 📌 Storage Tips | 储存建议
docs.text:
• Refrigerator | 冷藏: Store in an airtight container for up to 2 days 放入密封容器中冷藏，最多保存2天

  • Reheating | 重新加热: Reheat in a pot over low heat, stirring occasionally 用小火在锅中重新加热，偶尔搅拌

  • Freezing | 冷冻: Can be frozen for up to 1 month in a freezer-safe container 可放入冷冻安全容器中冷冻保存最多1个月

  • Thawing | 解冻: Thaw in refrigerator overnight before reheating 重新加热前在冰箱中解冻过夜

docs.title: Stir-Fried Broccoli | 清炒西兰花
docs.text: Quick Info | 快速信息 - ⏱️ Prep Time | 准备时间: 10 minutes | 10分钟 - 🔥 Cook Time | 烹饪时间: 5 minutes | 5分钟 - 🍽️ Servings | 份量: 2 servings | 2人份 - 📊 Difficulty | 难度: Easy | 简单

docs.title: 📝 Description | 菜品介绍
docs.text:
English: This classic Chinese-style stir-fried broccoli is quick, healthy, and retains the vegetable's natural crispiness and bright green color. Perfect as a side dish for any meal, it's rich in vitamins and takes only 15 minutes from start to finish.

中文： 这道经典中式清炒西兰花快速、健康，保留了蔬菜的天然脆爽和鲜绿色泽。作为任何餐点的配菜都非常完美，富含维生素，从开始到完成只需15分钟。

docs.title: 🥘 Ingredients | 食材清单
docs.text:
Ingredient 食材 Quantity 分量 Notes 备注 Broccoli 西兰花 300g 300克 Fresh, cut into florets 新鲜，切成小朵 Garlic 大蒜 10g 10克 Minced (2-3 cloves) 切末（2-3瓣） Salt 盐 3g 3克 To taste 适量 Cooking Oil 食用油 15ml 15毫升 Vegetable or peanut oil 植物油或花生油 Water 水 30ml 30毫升 For steaming 用于蒸煮

Notes on Measurements | 分量说明: - All measurements are precise in grams (g) or milliliters (ml) for consistency 所有分量均以克(g)或毫升(ml)为单位，保持一致性 - Adjust salt according to personal preference 盐可根据个人口味调整 - One medium broccoli head weighs approximately 300-350g 一个中等大小的西兰花头约重300-350克

docs.title: Step 1 | 第一步: Prepare the Broccoli | 准备西兰花
docs.text:
English: Wash the broccoli thoroughly under running water. Cut the broccoli into uniform small florets, about 3-4 cm in size. Peel and mince the garlic finely.

中文： 在流动水下彻底清洗西兰花。将西兰花切成均匀的小朵，大小约3-4厘米。大蒜去皮并切成细末。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Cutting the florets uniformly ensures even cooking and better presentation. 将小朵切得均匀可确保受热均匀且摆盘美观。

docs.title: Step 2 | 第二步: Heat the Pan | 热锅
docs.text:
English: Place a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add 15ml of cooking oil and swirl to coat the bottom evenly. Heat for about 30 seconds until the oil shimmers.

中文： 将炒锅或大煎锅置于中大火上。加入15毫升食用油，晃动使油均匀覆盖锅底。加热约30秒至油微微冒烟。

⚠️ Important | 注意事项: Don't let the oil smoke excessively, as this can create harmful compounds. 不要让油过度冒烟，否则会产生有害物质。

docs.title: Step 3 | 第三步: Stir-Fry | 翻炒
docs.text:
English: Add the minced garlic to the hot oil and stir-fry for 10-15 seconds until fragrant. Immediately add the broccoli florets and stir-fry vigorously for 1 minute.

中文： 将蒜末加入热油中，翻炒10-15秒至出香味。立即加入西兰花小朵，快速翻炒1分钟。

🌟 Pro Tip | 专业技巧: High heat and quick stirring help retain the broccoli's crunch and vibrant color. 大火快炒有助于保持西兰花的脆爽和鲜艳色泽。

docs.title: Step 4 | 第四步: Steam and Season | 蒸煮与调味
docs.text:
English: Add 30ml of water to the pan and immediately cover with a lid. Let it steam for 1-2 minutes. Remove the lid, add 3g of salt, and stir-fry for another 30 seconds until the water evaporates.

中文： 向锅中加入30毫升水，立即盖上锅盖。蒸煮1-2分钟。打开锅盖，加入3克盐，再翻炒30秒至水分蒸发。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: The brief steaming ensures the broccoli cooks through while staying crisp. 短暂蒸煮确保西兰花熟透同时保持脆爽。

docs.title: Step 5 | 第五步: Plate and Serve | 装盘上桌
docs.text:
English: Transfer the stir-fried broccoli to a serving plate. Serve immediately while hot and crispy.

中文： 将清炒西兰花装入盘中。趁热立即食用以保持脆爽口感。

docs.title: ✨ Characteristics | 菜品特点
docs.text:
Flavor Profile | 口味特点: - 🟢 Fresh and Light | 清新清淡 - 🟢 Crispy Texture | 口感脆爽 - 🟢 Subtle Garlic Aroma | 淡淡蒜香 - 🟢 Natural Sweetness | 天然甜味

Nutritional Highlights | 营养亮点: - High in Vitamin C (135% daily value per 100g) | 富含维生素C（每100克含每日所需135%） - Rich in Vitamin K and folate | 富含维生素K和叶酸 - Low in calories (only 34 kcal per 100g) | 低卡路里（每100克仅34千卡） - Excellent source of dietary fiber | 优质膳食纤维来源

Best Served | 最佳食用方式: - As a side dish with steamed rice | 作为蒸米饭的配菜 - Alongside tofu or tempeh dishes | 搭配豆腐或天贝菜肴 - Perfect for lunch or light dinner | 适合午餐或清淡晚餐 - Pairs well with noodle dishes | 与面食搭配佳

docs.title: 🔄 Variations | 变化做法
docs.text:
Option 1 | 做法一: Ginger Version | 姜味版 Replace garlic with 10g of minced ginger for a warming flavor. 用10克姜末替换大蒜，带来温暖的风味。

Option 2 | 做法二: Sesame Oil Finish | 香油版 Drizzle 5ml of sesame oil over the finished dish for extra aroma. 在成品上淋5毫升香油增加香气。

Option 3 | 做法三: Add Chili | 加辣版 Add 2g of dried chili flakes during stir-frying for a spicy kick. 翻炒时加入2克干辣椒碎增加辣味。

docs.title: 📌 Storage Tips | 储存建议
docs.text:
• Refrigerator | 冷藏: Store in an airtight container for up to 2 days 放入密封容器中冷藏，最多保存2天

  • Reheating | 重新加热: Reheat in a wok over high heat for 1-2 minutes to restore crispiness 用大火在炒锅中重新加热1-2分钟以恢复脆爽

  • Not recommended for freezing | 不建议冷冻: The texture becomes mushy after thawing 解冻后质地会变软烂，不建议冷冻

  • Best enjoyed fresh | 最好现做现吃: For optimal taste and nutrition, consume within 24 hours 为获得最佳口感和营养，建议在24小时内食用

docs.title: Stir-Fried Napa Cabbage | 清炒大白菜
docs.text: Quick Info | 快速信息 - ⏱️ Prep Time | 准备时间: 8 minutes | 8分钟 - 🔥 Cook Time | 烹饪时间: 4 minutes | 4分钟 - 🍽️ Servings | 份量: 1 serving | 1人份 - 📊 Difficulty | 难度: Easy | 简单

docs.title: 📝 Description | 菜品介绍
docs.text:
English: This simple stir-fried napa cabbage is a classic Chinese home-style dish that highlights the natural sweetness and crisp texture of the vegetable. Quick to prepare and low in calories, it's perfect for a light meal or as a side dish. The entire cooking process takes only 12 minutes.

中文： 这道简单的清炒大白菜是经典的中式家常菜，突出了蔬菜的天然甜味和脆爽口感。制作快速且低卡路里，非常适合作为清淡的一餐或配菜。整个烹饪过程仅需12分钟。

docs.title: 🥘 Ingredients | 食材清单
docs.text:
Ingredient 食材 Quantity 分量 Notes 备注 Napa Cabbage 大白菜 250g 250克 Fresh, washed 新鲜，洗净 Garlic 大蒜 8g 8克 Minced (2 cloves) 切末（2瓣） Salt 盐 2g 2克 To taste 适量 Cooking Oil 食用油 10ml 10毫升 Vegetable oil 植物油 Water 水 20ml 20毫升 For steaming 用于蒸煮

Notes on Measurements | 分量说明: - All measurements are precise in grams (g) or milliliters (ml) for consistency 所有分量均以克(g)或毫升(ml)为单位，保持一致性 - Adjust salt according to personal preference 盐可根据个人口味调整 - One medium napa cabbage leaf weighs approximately 50-60g 一片中等大小的大白菜叶约重50-60克

docs.title: Step 1 | 第一步: Prepare the Cabbage | 准备大白菜
docs.text:
English: Wash the napa cabbage thoroughly under running water. Separate the leaves and cut them into 4-5 cm wide strips. Peel and mince the garlic finely.

中文： 在流动水下彻底清洗大白菜。将菜叶分开，切成4-5厘米宽的条状。大蒜去皮并切成细末。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: Cut the white stem part and green leaf part separately, as they have different cooking times. 将白色菜帮和绿色菜叶分开切，因为它们的烹饪时间不同。

docs.title: Step 2 | 第二步: Heat the Pan | 热锅
docs.text:
English: Place a wok or frying pan over medium-high heat. Add 10ml of cooking oil and swirl to coat the bottom evenly. Heat for about 20 seconds until the oil is warm.

中文： 将炒锅或煎锅置于中大火上。加入10毫升食用油，晃动使油均匀覆盖锅底。加热约20秒至油温热。

⚠️ Important | 注意事项: Don't let the oil smoke, as this can affect the delicate flavor of the cabbage. 不要让油冒烟，否则会影响大白菜的细腻风味。

docs.title: Step 3 | 第三步: Stir-Fry the Stem | 翻炒菜帮
docs.text:
English: Add the minced garlic to the hot oil and stir-fry for 10 seconds until fragrant. First add the white stem parts of the cabbage and stir-fry for 1 minute until slightly softened.

中文： 将蒜末加入热油中，翻炒10秒至出香味。先加入大白菜的白色菜帮部分，翻炒1分钟至略微变软。

🌟 Pro Tip | 专业技巧: Cooking the stem first ensures both parts are perfectly done at the same time. 先炒菜帮可确保两部分同时达到完美熟度。

docs.title: Step 4 | 第四步: Add Leaves and Steam | 加入菜叶并蒸煮
docs.text:
English: Add the green leaf parts and 20ml of water to the pan. Immediately cover with a lid and let it steam for 1 minute. Remove the lid, add 2g of salt, and stir-fry for another 30 seconds until the water evaporates.

中文： 加入绿色菜叶部分和20毫升水到锅中。立即盖上锅盖，蒸煮1分钟。打开锅盖，加入2克盐，再翻炒30秒至水分蒸发。

💡 Tip | 小贴士: The brief steaming keeps the cabbage crisp-tender and preserves its nutrients. 短暂蒸煮保持大白菜脆嫩并保留营养。

docs.title: Step 5 | 第五步: Plate and Serve | 装盘上桌
docs.text:
English: Transfer the stir-fried napa cabbage to a serving plate. Serve immediately while hot to enjoy its fresh sweetness.

中文： 将清炒大白菜装入盘中。趁热立即食用以享受其清新甜味。

docs.title: ✨ Characteristics | 菜品特点
docs.text:
Flavor Profile | 口味特点: - 🟢 Light and Refreshing | 清淡爽口 - 🟢 Natural Sweetness | 天然甜味 - 🟢 Subtle Garlic Aroma | 淡淡蒜香 - 🟢 Crisp-Tender Texture | 脆嫩口感

Nutritional Highlights | 营养亮点: - Very low in calories (only 16 kcal per 100g) | 极低卡路里（每100克仅16千卡） - High in Vitamin C and K | 富含维生素C和K - Excellent source of dietary fiber | 优质膳食纤维来源 - Rich in antioxidants | 富含抗氧化物质

Best Served | 最佳食用方式: - As a light lunch with steamed rice | 作为清淡午餐配蒸米饭 - Alongside tofu or mushroom dishes | 搭配豆腐或蘑菇菜肴 - Perfect for dinner when watching calories | 控制卡路里时的完美晚餐选择 - Pairs well with noodle soups | 与面条汤搭配佳

docs.title: 🔄 Variations | 变化做法
docs.text:
Option 1 | 做法一: Vinegar Version | 醋溜版 Add 5ml of rice vinegar before plating for a tangy flavor. 装盘前加入5毫升米醋，带来酸爽风味。

Option 2 | 做法二: Ginger Version | 姜丝版 Replace garlic with 8g of julienned ginger for a warming taste. 用8克姜丝替换大蒜，带来温暖口感。

Option 3 | 做法三: Minimalist | 极简版 Skip the garlic and use only salt for the purest cabbage flavor. 省略大蒜，只用盐以获得最纯粹的大白菜风味。

docs.title: 📌 Storage Tips | 储存建议
docs.text:
• Refrigerator | 冷藏: Store in an airtight container for up to 1 day 放入密封容器中冷藏，最多保存1天

  • Reheating | 重新加热: Reheat in a pan over medium heat for 1 minute 用中火在锅中重新加热1分钟

  • Not recommended for freezing | 不建议冷冻: The texture becomes watery after thawing 解冻后质地会变水烂，不建议冷冻

  • Best enjoyed fresh | 最好现做现吃: For optimal taste, consume within a few hours 为获得最佳口感，建议在几小时内食用
